candidates.source_name: NEN – Národní elektronický nástroj (national e-procurement platform)
candidates.why_relevant: Mandatory e-procurement system for central state authorities and their subordinate organisations since 1 July 2018 (gov. resolution 408/2018). Tender documentation for banking/payment services names the contracting authority's contact person, project owner and often the responsible department/unit — a direct read on which state unit owns a payments programme and when a new unit appears.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled scraping of buyer profiles (e.g. /profil/mfcr) filtered by CPV 66100000/66110000/66172000/72000000; extract contact person, unit name, dates. Prefer NIPEZ open-data exports where available over HTML scraping.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs seed query + snowball from portal-vz.cz
queries_used: NEN Národní elektronický nástroj veřejná zakázka platební služby zadavatel
profil zadavatele Ministerstvo financí ČR E-ZAK tender arena veřejné zakázky

candidates.source_name: Věstník veřejných zakázek (new VVZ on NIPEZ)
candidates.why_relevant: Official Czech public procurement journal. Its search form supports contracting authority, IČO, CPV, contract type, winner name and winner IČO — so it yields both the state buyer and the supplier ecosystem for banking/payment contracts. Award notices are the earliest public trace of a new payments programme and its owning unit.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic form-based search by CPV (661*, 6617*) + NUTS CZ; capture form XML/HTML, parse contact point, authority unit, winner. Old domain vestnikverejnychzakazek.cz appears superseded — treat as redirect/legacy, not dead.
queries_used: Věstník veřejných zakázek vestnikverejnychzakazek.cz vyhledávání formulář

candidates.source_name: Registr smluv (Czech contract register, smlouvy.gov.cz)
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory register: obliged public bodies must publish contracts within 30 days of conclusion. Full contract PDFs name signatories, contract managers, and the organisational unit responsible — the richest public naming of state-side payments project owners. Administered by DIA since 1 April 2023 (Act 471/2022).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the register's open-data dumps / API rather than HTML; keyword-filter on 'platební terminál', 'platební služby', 'akceptace karet', 'bankovní služby', 'zpracování plateb'; extract signatory names and roles from contract attachments.
queries_used: Registr smluv smlouva platební terminály ministerstvo financí

candidates.source_name: TED – Tenders Electronic Daily (EU procurement notices)
candidates.why_relevant: Above-threshold Czech banking/payment tenders must be published EU-wide. TED gives structured, machine-readable notices filterable by CPV (66110000 banking services, 66172000 financial transaction processing), NUTS CZ, authority and winner — the cleanest cross-checkable feed for state payments buying and the supplier side.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: TED Search API / bulk XML packages; filter country=CZ, CPV 661*, notice types CN/CAN; join winner IČO back to Registr smluv.
queries_used: TED tenders europa eu Czech Republic banking payment services contract notice CPV 66110000

candidates.source_name: Hlídač státu – contracts & tenders aggregator with API
candidates.why_relevant: NGO aggregator that normalises Registr smluv, Věstník/VVZ, subsidies and company registers into one searchable base with a documented API. Best single entry point for cross-source snowballing: from a payments contract to the supplier, its other state customers, and the named officials.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Register for an API token; query /api/v2 datasets for smlouvy and verejnezakazky by CPV/keyword; treat as derived data — verify names against primary registers before use.
queries_used: Hlídač státu API smlouvy veřejné zakázky data hlidacstatu.cz

candidates.source_name: Portál o veřejných zakázkách (portal-vz.cz) – MMR methodology & NIPEZ hub
candidates.why_relevant: Ministry for Regional Development's methodological hub for NIPEZ/NEN/VVZ. Explains which systems are mandatory for whom and where each authority's buyer profile lives — the map you need before scraping, and it announces structural changes to the procurement systems themselves.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor 'aktuality' feed for system/registry changes; use as reference for CPV and profile ID resolution.
queries_used: NEN Národní elektronický nástroj veřejná zakázka platební služby zadavatel

candidates.source_name: Ministerstvo financí ČR – profil zadavatele & veřejné zakázky pages
candidates.why_relevant: The single most important state buyer for banking/treasury/payments in CZ (IČO 00006947, VVZ profile ID 508241). The page resolves which profile is live (NEN /profil/mfcr since 1.7.2018) versus legacy E-ZAK, and MF tender documents name the sponsoring department for Státní pokladna and payment projects.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Track NEN profile /profil/mfcr; keep mfcr.ezak.cz as historical archive for pre-2018 contracts.
queries_used: profil zadavatele Ministerstvo financí ČR E-ZAK tender arena veřejné zakázky

candidates.source_name: Otevřená data Ministerstva financí – seznam smluv MF ČR
candidates.why_relevant: MF's own open-data catalogue publishes a tabular list of its valid and invalid contracts — a lighter, structured alternative to scraping Registr smluv for this one high-value buyer, and it exposes contract counterparties in the payments/banking supplier ecosystem.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Pull the dataset distribution (CSV/JSON) on a monthly cadence; diff to detect new counterparties.
queries_used: Registr smluv smlouva platební terminály ministerstvo financí

candidates.source_name: SPCSS – Státní pokladna Centrum sdílených služeb, s.p. (career + corporate site)
candidates.why_relevant: State enterprise created to deliver the MF ICT strategy — eGovernment cloud, cybersecurity, data centres underpinning Státní pokladna. Its vacancy list is a direct A5 hiring signal: role titles reveal which platforms and units are being staffed up, and management pages reveal leadership changes.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl of /kariera/volne-pozice and /pracovni-pozice; diff postings; cross-check with the Jobs.cz company feed for postings not shown on-site.
queries_used: SPCSS Státní pokladna Centrum sdílených služeb kariéra volná místa

candidates.source_name: Česká národní banka – výběrová řízení (ČNB vacancies)
candidates.why_relevant: ČNB runs payment systems (CERTIS), currency circulation and settlement supervision. Vacancy announcements are titled by section/department, so the feed doubles as an org-structure signal for the payments and settlement units — plus internships. Contact uchazeci@cnb.cz.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl of the DC3VyberovaRizeni listing; parse section/department from the title; mirror against the cnb.cz/kariera landing page.
queries_used: ČNB volná pracovní místa kariéra platební styk sekce

candidates.source_name: ISoSS – Informační systém o státní službě (civil-service vacancy portal)
candidates.why_relevant: All announced selection procedures for vacant civil-service posts (služební místa) across ministries and agencies are published here. Announcements state the exact department, section and superior post — the canonical, statutory feed for public-sector hiring and for detecting newly created units at MF, ČSSZ, DIA, Finanční/Celní správa.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the 'evidence obsazovaných míst' listing; filter by service authority (MF, ČSSZ, DIA, GFŘ, GŘC) and by keywords 'platební', 'bankovní', 'státní pokladna', 'ICT'. Confirm whether an export/API exists before HTML scraping.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs query snowball from civil-service search
queries_used: ČSSZ výběrová řízení služební místa Česká pošta Poštovní spořitelna státní zakázka

candidates.source_name: ČSSZ – oznámení o vyhlášení výběrového řízení (documents section)
candidates.why_relevant: The Czech Social Security Administration is one of the largest state payment originators (pension and benefit disbursement) and a major ICT buyer. Its published selection-procedure PDFs name the department (e.g. data-centre unit) and the superior post — a fine-grained org-change signal.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the úřední deska / documents area for 'Oznámení – VO' PDFs; OCR/parse the unit and grade; also track ČSSZ as a buyer in NEN and Registr smluv.
queries_used: ČSSZ výběrová řízení služební místa Česká pošta Poštovní spořitelna státní zakázka

candidates.source_name: Digitální a informační agentura (DIA) – kariéra & org structure
candidates.why_relevant: Central authority for eID, trust services and public-sector information systems since 1 April 2023; also now the administrator of Registr smluv. Its career page publishes the org structure alongside vacancies (including senior posts such as deputy director with pay grade), giving both hiring and leadership-move signals for the state digital-payments interface layer.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl of /cs/kariera and /cs/o-nas (organizational structure); diff role titles and competence-centre naming.
queries_used: Digitální a informační agentura DIA kariéra volná místa organizační struktura platby

candidates.source_name: ISVS.CZ – eGovernment news site with a state-IT vacancy column
candidates.why_relevant: Trade outlet covering Czech public-sector information systems that republishes and comments on state-IT vacancies (e.g. 'Digitální a informační agentura hledá:'). Useful as an early-warning and editorial layer that flags which state units are staffing up, including payment/eGov platform teams.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: RSS/feed monitoring on vacancy and agency tags; store links and metadata only, not full text.
queries_used: Digitální a informační agentura DIA kariéra volná místa organizační struktura platby

candidates.source_name: Vhodné uveřejnění – buyer profiles & procurement commentary
candidates.why_relevant: Hosts buyer profiles for many authorities (incl. a Ministerstvo financí profile page) and publishes explainers on what VVZ vs. profil zadavatele vs. e-tržiště actually contain — a practical map of where a given authority's payment tenders are published when they are not in NEN.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use as a lookup for authority-to-platform mapping; scrape individual buyer profiles only where the authority actually publishes there.
queries_used: profil zadavatele Ministerstvo financí ČR E-ZAK tender arena veřejné zakázky
Věstník veřejných zakázek vestnikverejnychzakazek.cz vyhledávání formulář

candidates.source_name: Tender Arena – certified e-procurement tool & buyer profiles
candidates.why_relevant: One of the certified electronic tools (alongside NEN, E-ZAK, JOSEPHINE) used by ministries and municipalities that are not on NEN. Needed for completeness: a payments tender from a municipal or subordinate buyer may only appear here plus in VVZ.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate buyer profiles of relevant authorities (e.g. /profil/<code>) and monitor their published contracts; registration only if bidding-level data is needed.
queries_used: profil zadavatele Ministerstvo financí ČR E-ZAK tender arena veřejné zakázky

candidates.source_name: E-ZAK Ministerstvo financí ČR (legacy buyer profile archive)
candidates.why_relevant: MF's pre-1.7.2018 buyer profile, still completing procurements started there. Historical baseline for who ran which payment/banking procurement before the NEN migration — useful for tracing career paths of named project owners over a decade.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off historical harvest of contract listings; no ongoing polling needed.
queries_used: profil zadavatele Ministerstvo financí ČR E-ZAK tender arena veřejné zakázky

candidates.source_name: Celní správa ČR – card acceptance at customs offices
candidates.why_relevant: The Customs Administration operates its own payment terminals for duties, taxes and administrative fees, with published operating rules (per-terminal daily caps, one income type per terminal). Announcements of terminal rollouts imply a supplier contract and an owning operational unit — an indirect but concrete public-sector acquiring signal.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor 'aktuality' pages of regional customs offices for terminal/acceptance notices; pair each with a Registr smluv lookup for the acquiring contract.
queries_used: Finanční správa platba daně platební kartou zakázka poskytovatel platebních služeb "Celní správa"

candidates.source_name: Finanční správa ČR – placení daní / payment-service procurement statements
candidates.why_relevant: The tax administration has publicly discussed a tender to select a payment-card service provider and the pricing-model obstacle (percentage-of-turnover unacceptable at tax volumes). Q&A and CESOP pages also expose the payment-data reporting regime — both signal where a payments programme and its owning unit sit.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor placení daní and CESOP sections plus GFŘ press releases; correlate with GFŘ tenders in NEN/VVZ.
queries_used: Finanční správa platba daně platební kartou zakázka poskytovatel platebních služeb "Celní správa"

candidates.source_name: Česká pošta, s.p. – career portal (tvojebudoucnost.jobs.cz)
candidates.why_relevant: State-owned enterprise with ~33,000 employees and the counter network through which ČSOB/Poštovní spořitelna financial and payment products are distributed. Vacancy titles in financial-services and branch-network roles are a proxy for changes in the postal-banking interface; senior/ICT postings signal reorganisation.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl of the vacancy list; filter for finanční služby / bankovní / pokladní / ICT roles. Respect jobs.cz robots and rate limits.
queries_used: Česká pošta veřejné zakázky profil zadavatele kariéra volná místa platební služby

candidates.source_name: Vláda ČR – výběrová řízení (civil service portal, státní služba section)
candidates.why_relevant: Government Office listing of civil-service selection procedures, and the authoritative explanation of the process (announcement on the úřední deska + publication in ISoSS). Provides the rulebook needed to interpret vacancy notices as org-change evidence rather than routine churn.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl; use mainly as a reference and as a fallback when ISoSS scraping is blocked.
queries_used: ČSSZ výběrová řízení služební místa Česká pošta Poštovní spořitelna státní zakázka

candidates.source_name: Portál gov.cz – service pages for NEN, Registr smluv, VVZ, ISoSS
candidates.why_relevant: Canonical service catalogue that resolves the current official URL, administrator and legal basis of each register in this cell — the safest way to detect when a register is moved or re-hosted (e.g. Registr smluv moving from MV to DIA), which otherwise looks like a dead link.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly check of the relevant service pages (S8335 NEN, S9064 Registr smluv, S978 VVZ, S83366 služební místa) to validate endpoint URLs before a crawl run.
queries_used: NEN Národní elektronický nástroj veřejná zakázka platební služby zadavatel

negative_findings.description: No dedicated public page was found linking Poštovní spořitelna / ČSOB's postal-counter banking arrangement to a specific state tender or to named programme owners on the state side.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches combining ČSSZ, Česká pošta and Poštovní spořitelna with 'státní zakázka' returned only generic civil-service vacancy and Czech Post recruitment pages; the ČSOB partnership is described only in marketing terms on ceskaposta.cz.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The postal-banking interface is a structurally important CZ public-sector payments channel; without a documented source, org changes there will only be visible indirectly via Czech Post vacancies and ČSOB press releases.

negative_findings.description: The Věstník veřejných zakázek appears to have migrated from vestnikverejnychzakazek.cz to vvz.nipez.cz, but this was not confirmed by fetching either host.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search results reference both hosts; portal-vz.cz states the new Věstník is at vvz.nipez.cz. Old-domain search-form URLs still appear in results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector pinned to the legacy domain may silently harvest nothing or break; both endpoints must be tested by the deterministic verification pass before either is retired.

negative_findings.description: No confirmed machine-readable export or API was identified for ISoSS (portal.isoss.cz) civil-service vacancy data.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only descriptive references to ISoSS publication duties were found; the portal itself was not fetched and no dataset endpoint surfaced in search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: ISoSS is the highest-value A5 feed in this cell; if only HTML scraping is possible, collection cost and fragility rise materially.

negative_findings.description: No municipal-level (Praha, Brno, Ostrava, kraje) buyer profile was identified for banking/payment services within this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: Queries in this slice were centred on central-government actors; municipal acquiring/banking-services tenders were not searched in Czech.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Municipalities are a large, distinct segment of public-sector payment buying (fee collection, parking, card acceptance) with their own org units; leaving them out biases the cell toward central government.

negative_findings.description: NKÚ (Nejvyšší kontrolní úřad) audit reports were not searched in this run despite being an obvious 'who audits' category for state payments programmes.
negative_findings.result_summary: Not queried; category identified from first principles but not executed within the search budget.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: NKÚ audit conclusions routinely name programme owners, describe unit responsibilities and criticise governance — dense org-change evidence unavailable elsewhere.

coverage_gaps.description: Municipal and regional (obce, kraje, městské části) buyers of payment/acquiring services are unrepresented.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated cs pass on 'akceptace platebních karet obec', 'platební terminály město veřejná zakázka', 'kraj bankovní služby zakázka' across VVZ, NEN, Tender Arena, E-ZAK and Josephine buyer profiles.

coverage_gaps.description: Audit and oversight bodies (NKÚ, Úřad pro ochranu hospodářské soutěže / ÚOHS decisions on procurement challenges) not covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add NKÚ kontrolní závěry and the ÚOHS decision database (sbírky rozhodnutí) as indirect sources; ÚOHS decisions name the disputed tender, the authority and often internal responsibilities.

coverage_gaps.description: The supplier ecosystem revealed by contract awards (acquirers, processors, systems integrators) has no dedicated source yet — only the registers that name them.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a supplier watchlist from VVZ/TED winner fields, then track those firms' own career pages and ARES/Obchodní rejstřík statutory-body changes for leadership moves.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage of this cell is thin: only TED was captured in en, and no en-language reporting on Czech state payments procurement.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add en queries against TED, EU Commission country reports and English Czech outlets to catch cross-border supplier announcements not published in cs.

coverage_gaps.description: No URL in this slice was fetched; all endpoints are search-derived and unverified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness pass over every source_url and example_url, treating 403/timeouts as bot-defence rather than death, and confirm the VVZ domain migration.

brief: The Czech public-sector route to banking/payments org-change intelligence rests on four statutory registers — NEN (nen.nipez.cz), the Věstník veřejných zakázek (now vvz.nipez.cz), Registr smluv (smlouvy.gov.cz, administered by DIA since April 2023) and TED — which together name both the state project owners and the winning supplier ecosystem. Hiring and leadership signals come from a parallel statutory feed, ISoSS (portal.isoss.cz) for civil-service posts, complemented by the career pages of the state-enterprise layer: SPCSS, ČNB, DIA, ČSSZ and Česká pošta. Hlídač státu is the most efficient pointer/aggregator for cross-linking contracts, tenders and subjects via a documented API, with portal.gov.cz and portal-vz.cz as the authoritative map of which register currently lives where. The main weaknesses of this cell are the missing municipal tier, the absent audit layer (NKÚ, ÚOHS), and the fact that no URL here has yet been fetched — every endpoint is search-derived and awaits the deterministic liveness pass.
